metadata.title: When you get a kill doing literally nothing and Valorant’s like ‘You earned this’
metadata.description:
Wait, I just stood there and got a kill?
Enemy must’ve been on break or confused.
Click if your best plays are 100% accidental chaos.
Valorant logic at its finest again.

Tap in if your kills don’t make sense either!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
